mode: static file parsing only, the specimen is never loaded or executed

confidence_scale.H: structurally proven from the file, an instruction or an immediate settles it
confidence_scale.M: derived from the file but conditional on one run time precondition
confidence_scale.L: weak, the mechanism is known but the instance data is absent from the file
confidence_scale.OPEN: not decidable from the file alone, carried as an open question

derivation: flag bit 0 is inverted into zero or one
the inverted value is scaled by five
the scaled value is added to the anchor address

variants.flag_bit_0_clear: the patch site equals rec + 0x00 and the region is five bytes
variants.flag_bit_0_set: the patch site equals rec + 0x00 - 5 and the region is seven bytes

relative_displacement.note: described symbolically, no displacement value is emitted

second_store.lands_on: the anchor, which is patch site + 5, the upper edge of the seven byte window
second_store.note: the store lands on the upper edge of the region, not below it, and the stored short jump is the only reference back into the lower five bytes of the region

stores.role: the leading byte of the five byte relative jump
a short jump that returns into the five byte group

region.adjacency: with flag bit 0 set the patch site is rec + 0x00 - 5, so the two groups are adjacent and together they cover the whole seven byte window

coverage.flag_bit_0_clear: only the five byte group runs, the region is the anchor itself
coverage.flag_bit_0_set: both groups run, the region is the five byte group plus the two byte group on top of it

region.note: the patcher contains no target size, page boundary or per byte validation

slot.holds: pointer to an array of index times 0x38 records

capacity_model.growth: doubling, the byte count is the new capacity times the stride
capacity_model.allocator: KERNEL32!HeapAlloc and KERNEL32!HeapReAlloc on the private heap published at 0x1830D44F0

globals.name: region_free_list
globals.purpose: head of the reusable region list owned by the arena

globals.name: spin_lock
globals.purpose: hand rolled interlocked spin lock, the contention counter is unbounded and every holder re-checks its own precondition, so it is a mutual exclusion lock and not a one shot initialiser

globals.name: heap_handle
globals.purpose: private KERNEL32!HeapCreate(0, 0, 0) handle, zero in the file and published by its only writer, the init that itself has no direct caller

globals.name: record_array
globals.purpose: pointer to the record array, zero until the registrar allocates it

globals.name: capacity
globals.purpose: allocated record count of the array

globals.name: count
globals.purpose: live record count and the upper bound of every index scan

lock.not_a_once_flag: every holder re-checks its own precondition after the acquire, so the flag excludes holders instead of firing once

sequence: the threshold compare only saturates the Sleep argument
Sleep is called with zero or one millisecond
the retry counter is incremented and nothing is compared against it
the jump returns to the same lock cmpxchg
contention_path.sleep_argument: 0 below 0x20, 1 millisecond at and above it
contention_path.yield_policy: a sleep of at most one millisecond, the counter itself is never bounded

single_release_point.note: every orchestrator exit path converges on this block, so the lock is released exactly once on each path, including the failure codes

why_not_the_process_heap: the only writer of the global is the instruction right after the single HeapCreate call site, so the handle is the return value of that call
all three arguments of that call are zeroed immediately before it, so the call is HeapCreate(0, 0, 0)
KERNEL32.dll!GetProcessHeap is called from 7 sites in the file and none of them lies inside the component range 0x1D280-0x1E9D0
the matching release is a KERNEL32.dll!HeapFree on the same handle, which is the private heap ownership contract and would be wrong for the process heap
heap.allocator: KERNEL32!HeapAlloc and KERNEL32!HeapReAlloc on the private heap published at 0x1830D44F0, the record array and the thread id array share it

on_zero.note: the failure branch jumps to the shared release and return block, so it leaves the function before any patcher call site

reachability_evidence.form_note: the two rip operand fields count sections, not sites, and they cover the rip relative operand form only; an absolute pointer, an rva32 or va64 literal is a separate form and is not counted

activation.reason: the gate is the only thing that lets the orchestrator leave its early exits, the only writer of the tested handle is inside the init, and the init has no direct call site anywhere in the file, so no assignment reachable inside the decoded control flow graph satisfies the test
activation.runtime_caveat: an indirect call, a function pointer, run time code generation or a writer outside the image cannot be excluded from the file, so the gate is not decidable at run time

fields.name: anchor
fields.value_expr: absolute address of the patch anchor, resolved at registration time
fields.note: identity key of the record, registration and lookup both compare it

fields.name: destination
fields.value_expr: absolute address that the relative jump resolves to
fields.note: read as a low dword only, so the stored value has to fit in 32 bits

fields.name: image_base
fields.value_expr: base of the executable image rebuilt for this record
fields.note: taken from the arena block, the bytes inside it are produced by the list builder

fields.name: original_bytes
fields.target_expr: snapshot of the bytes that occupy the patch region
fields.value_expr: seven bytes when flag bit 0 is set, otherwise five
fields.note: copied from live target memory at registration time, no reader in the analysed set, its width equals the seven byte variant of the patch region

fields.name: flags
fields.value_expr: bit 0 layout, bit 1 skip, bit 2 patched, upper bits preserved on merge
fields.note: the patcher mutates the record it has just consumed

fields.name: list_count
fields.target_expr: rec + 0x24 & 0x0F, entry count of both lists
fields.value_expr: low nibble of the dword, zero when the record carries no list
fields.note: only the low nibble is replaced, the upper three bytes are preserved

fields.name: offset_list
fields.value_expr: one byte per entry, index zero is the oldest entry
fields.note: parallel to 0x30, one index selects both halves

fields.name: displacement_list
fields.value_expr: one byte per entry, offset inside the rebuilt image
fields.note: a zero byte makes the matching entry inert

list_builder_limits.note: both limits are compared inside the list builder, exceeding either one abandons the record instead of truncating it

producers.name: registrar
producers.role: allocates the record, fills every field, rejects duplicate anchors

producers.name: list_builder
producers.role: walks the anchor with the length decoder and fills the two byte lists

producers.name: arena
producers.role: hands out executable blocks and keeps a reusable region list

producers.name: init
producers.role: creates the private heap under the spin lock and publishes it, and has no direct caller in the file

producers.name: decoder
producers.role: supplies instruction lengths to the list builder

consumers.name: patcher
consumers.role: consumes the anchor, the destination and the flag byte

consumers.name: rip_redirect
consumers.role: consumes both byte lists and the count nibble

consumers.name: orchestrator
consumers.role: enumerates records and dispatches both patcher call sites

bits.name: two_slot_layout
bits.gate: selector of the patch site expression
bits.meaning: set when the anchor is preceded by a run of five identical filler bytes, so the relative jump is placed five bytes lower and the region grows to seven bytes

bits.name: skip
bits.gate: skip gate of every record enumeration
bits.meaning: every enumeration in the analysed set ignores a record with this bit, and the patcher sets it together with bit 2

bits.name: patched
bits.gate: marker that the patcher already processed the record
bits.meaning: written only by the patcher flag update, never read by the analysed set

bits.name: preserved_bits
bits.gate: carried through the registrar merge untouched
bits.meaning: bits 3 to 7 are never cleared by the registrar, which keeps the slot bits and merges only bit 0

patch_flag.not_written_when: the first protection change fails, the write sits on the success path only
patch_flag.written_even_when: the restore and the cache flush results are unchecked, so the state is published before the outcome is known
patch_flag.effect: a processed record is skipped by every later enumeration in the analysed set and no analysed code clears the skip bit again, so the analysed paths reach a record at most once

inert_conditions: flag bit 1 is set on the record
the low nibble of rec + 0x24 is zero
rec + 0x10 plus the entry of rec + 0x30 is zero

consistency.rule: the entry count has to stay inside the 8 bytes that 0x28 and 0x30 own inside the 0x38 stride
consistency.evidence: the builder compares its counter with 0x8 and abandons the record above it

consistency.rule: the stored count dword is reduced to four bits, so a count above fifteen could not survive the merge
consistency.evidence: the registrar masks the new count with 0xF and the reader masks with 0xF

consistency.rule: a zero nibble makes the record inert for the context rewrite even when the eight stored bytes are not zero
consistency.evidence: the reader branches out before the first list load when the masked count is zero

consistency.rule: one loop counter drives both loads, so entry i of 0x28 always pairs with entry i of 0x30
consistency.evidence: the same counter appears in the address of both byte loads

consistency.rule: the registrar always stores all eight bytes of both lists, so entries beyond the count are defined but never read
consistency.evidence: two eight byte stores per record, independent of the count

returns.restore_failure: not represented in the return value
returns.cache_flush_failure: not represented in the return value

callers.index_source: the index of the record whose rec + 0x00 equals the argument
callers.preconditions: a record with a matching anchor exists and has flag bit 1 clear
callers.on_failure: the failure code of the patcher becomes the return value

callers.activation_reason: the shared gate at 0x1E3A4 tests the private heap handle, whose only writer is the uncalled init, so the path has no satisfying assignment inside the decoded control flow graph | the path specific gates 0x1E4A6 live record count is zero -> 0x4, 0x1E4E3 flag bit 1 is set on the located record -> 0x5 decide the path only after the shared gate is open

unresolved.question: which records the table holds at run time, and which module and export each anchor belongs to
unresolved.reason: the table slot is zero filled in the file and its only writer takes already resolved addresses, so no instance can be enumerated statically

unresolved.question: what invokes the registrar and the init, that is, what supplies the anchor and destination pair and who publishes the private heap
unresolved.reason: the file contains no direct call site and no rip relative reference to either function, and the init is the only writer of the private heap handle

unresolved.question: what invokes the orchestrator that holds both patcher call sites
unresolved.reason: the file contains no direct call site and no rip relative reference to the orchestrator, and its heap gate at 0x1E3A4 tests the private heap handle whose only writer is the uncalled init, so the gate has no satisfying assignment inside the decoded control flow graph and the orchestrator returns 0x2 before either call site

unresolved.question: what the flag bits 3 to 7 of a record mean and which code sets them
unresolved.reason: the analysed set only preserves those bits on merge, no reader and no other writer exists in the three consumers
